name: Induwara Samaranayaka
bio:
I'm a Software Engineer with over 2 years of hands-on experience at Thakshana Technologies, working closely with embedded systems in real-world, on-site engineering environments — including UAE-based deployments. My expertise spans low-level programming with C/C++, Python, and C#, along with modern full-stack tools like Node.js and Flutter.

At Thakshana, I’ve led the development of cross-platform software solutions that interface with STM, FPGA, and Microchip hardware, combining robust back-end APIs with user-centric interfaces. I thrive in Linux-based environments, where performance, reliability, and system integration are paramount.

Currently pursuing a Master’s in Advanced Software Engineering, I bring a strong foundation in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Moratuwa, with a deep drive to bridge hardware and software through innovative, scalable solutions.

name: Madusha Shanaka
bio: Results-driven Software Engineer with nearly 3 years of experience in full-stack development using Java, Spring Framework, Spring MVC, Hibernate, Spring JPA, and JavaScript frameworks. Proficient in designing scalable, high-performance applications, developing complex SQL/PLSQL queries, DB triggers and stored procedures, and building secure RESTful APIs. Skilled in end-to-end live release management using Jenkins pipelines, Linux server operations, and Git-based workflows. Experienced in optimizing system performance through code profiling, query tuning, and root cause analysis. Having experience collaborating in Agile environments and providing reliable software solutions that meet evolving business and technical requirements.
